statement: Source pins demonstrate an SDL3 Triton HIDAPI driver and 28de:1302/1303 controller mapping in stable release-3.4.0, absent as a Triton source file at inspected release-3.2.30; release-3.4.10 contains a changed Triton rumble report path and release notes call out a new Steam Controller rumble fix. The supported fact is the public consumer version/source transition, not physical successful haptics or that all apps ship this SDL build. SDL3 3.4.0 driver 281-339 and controller_list.h 605-606; SDL3 3.4.10 driver 594-623.

applicability.revision: SDL tags and pinned public engine documents inspected 2026-10-27; device revision not measured
applicability.scope: Direct USB 28de:1302 consumer software; versions and engine middleware only; no live test
